desc:
Welcome to Drive City, a large open-world racing game where you can enjoy a realistic car driving expirence with detailed interiors. 
Race with friends, ride hypers, sports, supercars and anything else you want! Roam around a HUGE map and get your dream cars!

⚠️ GAME IS STILL IN BETA ⚠️

🚗 Collect over 50+ cars!
🔧 Customize your Car!
🌎 Explore a large vast realistic open world Map!
🏎️ Race with your friends! 

⭐ Inviting Friends gives you Cash Bonuses and other Rewards!
👥 You will get +5% MORE Cash Earning bonus for each friend you invite (25% Max)

🌟 Premium users earn +5% more money when driving!
✨ Group Members get rewarded a free group vehicle!

Created with ❤️ by Drive City Corporation
Click the '🔔' for Update Notifications!
